head: codex/g2-n6-native-snapshot
title: G2-N6: expose native spatial snapshots and prebuilt map initialization
body:
Precolored scans currently stop at ColorCloudMap without a source-bound native 3D snapshot for G2. This adds an opt-in quiescent snapshot API, frame-0 prebuilt geometry/color initialization, and native Room/object grouping for the PSM-WMA spatial preview adapter.

**Stacked Draft on PR #7** (`e86c3844325b13092e1713290b079cfb63466cfb`). Fixed implementation: **`2009fae35d86579bb22c273fb97ec1bf0835b533`**, tree `9fc89f461f9edbdd3ebae3684412eb3bd20c1b3f`. Related to [PSM-WMA #26](https://github.com/wxwy/psm_wma/issues/26); companion implementation `c7ebb429074be5726ff9abead0e0d930a7e2138d`. Keep Draft and unmerged.

### Resulting behavior
- Export actual ColorCloudMap, native grid tri-state bytes, Room footprints/IDs, ObjectMap/SG IDs, source part/joint provenance, meshes and native hierarchy/portal relations. Source/build/frame identity and scene-transition locks reject stale or mixed captures.
- Initialize normal geometry from a separately evidenced frame-0 occupancy grid and precolored world cloud while keeping genuine RGB-D and native object processing active. No MuJoCo dependency or Cosmos images enter generic C++.
- Add a bounded recorded replay profile that requires genuine RGB-D/pose and model observations, exact source binding, first/final semantic frames, native ACK and current color-worker state. Existing N3 behavior stays active without the opt-in.
- Compute grouping in native C++ from strict 3D bbox gap <0.30 m within native Rooms. Floor/Wall roots never relay separate object components. Generic changes are mirrored to the historical mapping tree; recorded MapROS integration is limited to the active tree.

### Author validation
- Fresh active-tree ROS Noetic Catkin build PASS.
- **129 distinct C++ testcases PASS** across 18 XMLs, including 9 new cases; zero failure/error/skip. Catkin wrapper-inclusive total 258 is not the distinct count.
- Native Python regression: **449 passed, 73 skipped**; skips require optional CPU torch in existing model-service/pooling tests. Six new recorded-adapter checks pass.
- **6 TEST_ONLY native invocations**, rectangular/L-shaped/doorway × ESDFGrid/GVD, frame 0/200; **12 actual snapshots** sealed/rendered by G2. Native object IDs, 0.20 m saved-state movement and source part/joint fields checked.
- Four-frame synthetic normal prebuilt geometry/input smoke PASS; no genuine model execution is claimed.
- Generated build-source SHA256: `7a8ff690e150956d59f7b2773561034e4956a5344190f7e1d08135d4c92c4bae`. Published Git tree exactly matches the tested source; companion inventory verifies 43 native files.

### Open acceptance
**Ordinary native structural roots are NOT IMPLEMENTED.** Even genuine object observations remain structurally blocked for complete Floor/Upper/cardinal/Island output. Diagnostic source roots cannot bless normal perception. Oblique/complex walls are conservatively incomplete; the L-shaped test creates no Island, and the doorway still yields one Room.

Original Layout 1/10 frame 0/200, whole-house materials, genuine YOLOE/SigLIP replay and human visual acceptance remain pending. Issue #26 stays open. No parent PR, V3 source, Gitlink, cache, training, GPU task or production ref changes.

[Native contract and commands](https://github.com/wxwy/nav_sg/blob/codex/g2-n6-native-snapshot/docs/G2_N6_NATIVE_SNAPSHOT.md) · [Companion runbook and evidence](https://github.com/wxwy/psm_wma/blob/codex/g2-n6-prescan-native-views/docs/build/PSM-WMA_G2_N6_implementation_runbook_2026-11-08.md)

head: codex/g2-n6-prescan-native-views
title: G2-N6: add pre-scan source adapter and native spatial previews
body:
G2 has no source-bound path from MuJoCo visual surfaces through native nav_sg outputs into spatial view assets. This adds isolated simulation/source, native-bundle and view modules for [Issue #26](https://github.com/wxwy/psm_wma/issues/26).

**Draft on V3 `7b8b733e1f585bb44a0eac7c14ad545c29355a86`. Fixed implementation: `c7ebb429074be5726ff9abead0e0d930a7e2138d`, tree `6aa4204f81fa5360cf07f487d986c88087478ac9`.** A later handoff/evidence-only successor preserves all runtime bytes. Native companion: [branch](https://github.com/wxwy/nav_sg/tree/codex/g2-n6-native-snapshot), fixed `2009fae35d86579bb22c273fb97ec1bf0835b533`, stacked on unchanged PR #7. Keep Draft and unmerged; Issue #26 stays open.

### Behavior
- `g2/sim` loads verified MJCF/assets and saved states, explicitly separates visual/collision/robot roles, samples actual supported asset albedo/UVs and exports bounded world XYZRGB with color validity/provenance. No camera rendering, fake pose, physics rollout or ordinary GT detection injection.
- `g2/nav_bridge` seals actual native IDs, memberships, source parts/joints, meshes, relationships, colors and full tri-state grid bytes with source/frame/build/hash checks. Room/Island grouping remains in native C++.
- `g2/views` uses a shared metric orthographic renderer: House Floor/Upper plus four Room cardinal assets, and four separate assets per native Island. It preserves unknown regions, geometry occlusion, world scale, depth and an explicit native-ID index table. Original 3D is retained.
- A plan-only recorded adapter binds original model/states/ep_meta to genuine recorded RGB-D and matching native model observations. It requires the recorded `world` frame and never executes inference.

### Author evidence
- **64/64 G2 Python tests PASS**, zero failure/error/skip.
- Companion active-tree native build PASS; **129 distinct C++ cases PASS**, including 9 new, zero failure/error/skip.
- Native Python regression **449 passed, 73 skipped** for optional CPU-torch model-service/pooling tests.
- **6 TEST_ONLY native invocations / 12 frame 0/200 snapshots** sealed and rendered, covering rectangular/L-shaped/doorway × ESDFGrid/GVD.
- Four-frame normal prebuilt geometry/input smoke PASS without semantic acceptance.
- Published trees exactly match tested source; readback verifies 15 PSM and 43 native file hashes. Separate read-only code review closed reported findings for the Draft scope.

### Acceptance still open
**Ordinary native structural roots are NOT IMPLEMENTED**, so complete normal Floor/Upper/cardinal/Island output remains blocked even with genuine object observations. Diagnostic source roots cannot certify normal perception. The L-shaped case conservatively yields no Island; the doorway still yields one Room.

Original Layout 1/10 frame 0/200, whole-house material completeness, genuine recorded YOLOE/SigLIP execution and human visual review are NOT_RUN/pending. Unsupported primitive/cube/opacity/translucent appearance fails or produces explicit partial artifacts with no COMPLETE. Views remain spatial previews with `training_ready=false`, never temporal video.

No Cosmos source, Gitlink, V3 production training/dataset/cache, GPU or simulation evaluation changes. Child/Gitlink stays `1ca308055fc41fb69efaeb9efaa23808f164a18e`. Existing nav_sg PR #2/#4/#6/#7 are unchanged.
